_comment: Example of %AppData%\PixelPaws\settings.json. The real file lives in your AppData folder, NOT in this repo. Never paste a real API key into a file you commit. Configure everything from the Settings window instead.
_comment_quiet: Settle the cat down while you present, screen-share, game full-screen, or have focus assist on. hideWhenPresenting goes further and hides it entirely, which also stops the render loop.
_comment_continuity: Wake up where the cat was, in the mood it was in. The last* values are written by the app; you don't need to set them.
_comment_productivity: Productivity Hub and Pomodoro focus timer configuration.
_comment_agent: Coding Agent Companion (passive local observer on 127.0.0.1, zero AI models or keys).
_comment_targetFps: Simulation ticks per second; 0 follows the display. Not in the Settings UI because it saves nothing — the cost is being subscribed to WPF's render loop at all, not the work per tick. Only useful to cap a very high refresh-rate display.
